business_problem: Booking.com employees across HR, IT, Legal, and Finance had to navigate org charts and manual routing paths just to get help, causing misrouted tickets and slower resolution.
solution_summary: Booking.com employees across HR, IT, Legal, and Finance had to navigate org charts and manual routing paths just to get help, causing misrouted tickets and slower resolution. Booking.com implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around AI Agents, IT Service Management, HR Service Delivery, and CRM. Key components included AI Agents run AI-driven triage and response tasks; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; HR Service Delivery manages HR cases and onboarding; CRM contributes account and opportunity context. The stack also connected Legal and Finance so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by AI Agents, and uses context from CRM, Legal, and Finance before IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery routes or fulfills the work.

solution_components.name: AI Agents
solution_components.role: Execute AI-driven routing, triage, and response tasks inside support workflows.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Moves HR cases, onboarding, and employee support workflows onto the same platform.

solution_components.name: CRM
solution_components.role: Contributes customer, opportunity, or account context into ServiceNow workflows.

data_flow: Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by AI Agents, and uses context from CRM, Legal, and Finance before IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.
business_outcome: Booking.com now routes tickets correctly 97% of the time, has cut resolution times by 33%, and operates one support platform for roughly 16,200 employees.
